steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Darius sent a fleet in 490 BC to punish Athens and Eretria for supporting the Ionian Revolt; Eretria was sacked | Key Fact: The Persian force landed at Marathon, guided by the exiled Athenian tyrant Hippias | Key Fact: The Athenians marched to Marathon and were joined by 1,000 Plataeans; they were heavily outnumbered | Key Fact: Miltiades persuaded the Athenians to attack; the Greeks strengthened their wings and thinned their centre

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the battle of marathon (490 bc), and one past-paper question.
